paragraphs: Chalfa bar Idi and R. Chiyya, in R. Yosi's name: Rabbah, Metzora, section 16. In that matter in Eikhah Rabbah, on “Depart, unclean,” it is R. Chalfo bar Zevid and R. Berekhiah, in Issi's name.
